title: Shinonome Ena — That Drawing, Together〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “The me in the mirror”...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mr. Yukihira sure doesn't make his assignments easy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How should I depict that? Interpreting it literally doesn't feel right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I should...bring out what's inside me, what can't be seen with the eye... Mirror... An image... An idealization...
<Ena, is now a good time?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Rin? Sure, you can come out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't know you were with her, Len. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um... You said your new homework for art class was really hard, so we wanted to come see how you were doing...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right. I told you about it in SEKAI, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Ena. Is that a mirror you're holding?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's right. The assignment theme is “the me in the mirror”, but the mirror part is what I'm having trouble with...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, mirrors don't just reflect how you look. They can show your inner self, or ward against evil or so on. They've got mystical symbolism and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So there are different ways to interpret the assignment, and that changes how I could go about illustrating it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I really need to decide on a direction soon, though.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Maybe you should take a break?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh... I was just thinking about saying that myself...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um... A change of pace might help you come up with a good idea.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're right. I'm struggling to focus right now, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think I'll go take a walk in SEKAI. Do you two want to join me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah...!>
Empty SEKAI
Lake

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And here I am. Let's see, where are Len and Rin...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hi, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, there you are! Okay, want to just wander around the—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Something just flashed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (What was that? Something doesn't feel right...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it must have been this. See? This shard-looking thing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena, that's...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah! What's going on? It's so bright!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?! Where are we?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is the SEKAI of that fragment of a feeling you picked up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Fragment of a feeling? Aren't those supposed to be round? The thing I picked up looked like a shard of glass.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... You mean that was like a little piece of one that had broken off?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: P-Probably... Sorry, we should have realized sooner...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's not your fault. I'm the one who picked it up without thinking.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The lights are quite bright and we're pretty far away, but I can see a bunch of pictures and photos hung up. Is this like a museum or something?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes. But there are pictures on the floor, too...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...
se_run_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What is it, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I knew it... This is your art, Ena. See? Look.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Over here, too... Oh, and those over there too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And it's not just my art, either. A lot of these photos are photos of me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But why?
Because this place was born from your and my feelings.
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A little me?!

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, current me.

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: You've really kept me waiting, huh? I've been calling for you forever.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Calling? For me?

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: Ever since you lost me, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? I have no idea what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: I already said...

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: Well...there was a lot I wanted to say to you, but it's okay now.

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: It seems like you finally noticed, after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Noticed what? How am I supposed to get what you're saying if you won't just come out with it already?

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: I wanted to tell you more, too! It's your own fault for leaving it until the very last minute.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Leaving what? I don't—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you glowing?

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: Because I have to go now.

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: Aww. I wanted to go see the picture together...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena! Grab her!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: O-Or grab her hand! That will work too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh! I want a full explanation later!

rows.Speaker: Little Ena?
rows.Line: Phew...that was a shock. What is it with this place and all the flashing, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: E-Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Little Ena?
rows.Line: Oh, I'm okay. I was just a little surprised by that bright flash.

rows.Speaker: Little Ena?
rows.Line: So, where'd the little me go? I made sure to hold her hand and everything...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, Rin... Does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She looks like the little Ena, but I think this is our Ena on the inside.
